results.snippet: backward-kill-word (Alt+Backspace): Deletes the previous sequence of "word characters" (letters, digits, underscores) but stops at whitespace. For example, if your cursor is after " hello" (with spaces before "hello"), Alt+Backspace will only delete "hello", leaving the spaces intact.
